sys_di_key.description:
Extract the total revenue or sales figure for the financial year from this document.
This field may appear under any of these labels: - Revenue, Total Revenue, Net Revenue - Sales, Total Sales, Sales Accounts, Net Sales - Turnover, Total Turnover, Gross Turnover - RMS Concrete Sales, Concrete Sales - CC Road Works / Drain Works / Sachivalayam Works (sum all if broken into project lines) - Income from Business, Gross Receipts - Total Income from Operations
Rules: - Extract the TOP-LINE revenue figure only (before deducting any returns or discounts) - If revenue is broken into multiple project/product lines, return the TOTAL/SUM - If the document shows both current year and previous year columns, extract CURRENT YEAR only - Remove commas, currency symbols. Return plain number only. - If not found, return: NA
sys_di_key.name: Total Sales / Revenue
